name: Cholismo
scopeNote: Cholismo as applied by Diego Simeone at Atlético Madrid from his presentation on 2011-12-27 (first match 2012-01-07) onward; core evidence 2013/14 plus later seasons. Sources use 'cholismo' for the philosophy (collective over individual, intensity, partido a partido) and 'deep and narrow 4-4-2' for the shape. The popular label 'modern catenaccio' is contested: These Football Times says marking is not as rigidly man-orientated and calls the comparison an oversimplification; Spielverlagerung says full-backs man-mark wingers within a zonal compact 4-4-2. Atlético also use high/medium/low blocks and back-three variants later, so the 'low-block 4-4-2' label is a simplification.
openQuestions: Appointment date: Atlético announced Simeone around 2011-12-23 (from memory, unverified); profilePeriod uses the 2011-12-27 presentation verified on the club page.

Marking: sources disagree in emphasis (Spielverlagerung: full-backs man-mark wingers; TFT: not rigidly man-orientated; a 2016 Bayern breakdown seen only in a search summary: zonal-man hybrid, unverified).
Public sources for Simeone's own 'partido a partido' quote were not dated; earliest found is the 2011-12-27 presentation 'vivo el día a día'.
Free pre-2020 Coaches' Voice or StatsBomb data on 2011-14 set pieces not found.
